snippets.snippet: ORDINANCE NO. 2025-02 Section 3 . ABANDONMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES No person shall abandon any motor vehicles on any public or private property within the corporate limits of the Village. A vehicle will be considered abandoned if it is left for more than seventy-two (72) hours on private property without the permission of a person having the right to the possession of the property, or if it is left for more than forty-eight (48) hours on a public street or other property open to the public for purposes of vehicular travel or parking, within the right-of-way of any road. Section 4 . IMPOUNDING The Chief of Police, or any member of his Department designated by him, is hereby authorized to remove any vehicle abandoned within the Village in violation of this Ordinance. Such vehicle shall be impounded until lawfully claimed or disposed of in accordance with the Ohio Revised Code. Section 5 . NOT

ORDINANCE NO. 2025-02 Section 7 . LIABILITY The Village of Port Washington, its officials, employees, and/or agents, shall assume no liability whatsoever for any personal property that is abandoned or allowed to remain on private property; that has been taken into custody; or that is stored or disposed of, as provided above. Section 8 . EXCEPTIONS (a) The provisions of this Ordinance shall not apply to junk motor vehicle(s), junk motor vehicle part(s), or motor vehicle(s) in an inoperative condition that are fully enclosed within a garage or other suitable permanent structure. (b) The provisions of this Ordinance shall not apply to any lawfully operated and duly licensed auto wrecking yards and/or junk yards, and/or scrap metal processing facilities. Section 9 .
